members.name: agent.list
members.note: No-argument SDK lists host-observed shared task loops since the current observation lifecycle, not agent definitions. members.name: fs.write

Requires an explicit non-immediate user action holding the same physical thread lease captured at host entry; release, handoff and identical-id/timestamp reacquisition cannot revive it. Automatic hooks and unleased UI callbacks cannot write. Retains the native 16000 JSON-character parameter budget instead of upstream 4 MiB. Hook short-circuit void is not native execution evidence or business PASS; downstream native errors reject, and late rejection does not claim filesystem rollback.

members.name: fs.list

Legacy hook results may omit added fields; invalid present fields are rejected. Dangling stat targets still reject instead of providing upstream link-only metadata; arbitrary filesystem access remains unavailable.

renderComponents.name: AskUserQuestion
renderComponents.note: Native request_user_input wording uses the original schema; answer identity, option order and labels stay fixed. renderComponents.name: UserMessage
renderComponents.note: Visible text blocks only; model, stored history and copy retain original text. origin is unclassified, isExpanded is the desktop expand toggle, terminal onScreen/task/from absent. 10000 chars and 32 owners; larger content keeps native rendering. No embedded Client. Electron message3 verifies two turns, reload and off.

renderComponents.name: AssistantMessage
renderComponents.note: Visible text only; host-owned first-of-reply/header, model input and stored history unchanged. No terminal onScreen or embedded Client. 10000 chars and 32 owners; overflow stays native. Electron message3 verifies two turns, reload and off.

renderComponents.name: ToolUse
renderComponents.note: Visible nonapproval detail only; original headers, approvals, raw arguments and execution state remain host-owned. Input display may change within bounded JSON. No terminal geometry or embedded Clients.

renderComponents.name: ToolResult
renderComponents.note: Visible nonapproval result presentation only; original stored/model tool results, raw result, tool identity and error state are preserved. Oversized or non-JSON output keeps native renderer.

renderComponents.name: ToolGroup
renderComponents.notes: Per-message native tool cards; bounded 32 calls/10000 JSON chars. isExpanded controls detail defaults; native headers, errors, approvals and manual toggles remain. Custom trees augment the group. No terminal run folding/onScreen or non-Pane Client.

renderComponents.name: ToolProgress
renderComponents.note: Added in the latest pinned declaration. CMB tool execution progress has no Function Mods render interception; not claimed by matching ToolUse or Pane.

renderComponents.name: CommandOutput
renderComponents.note: Mods command job text only. Execution state and command identity are read-only; unavailable stored arguments are masked as ***. Native slash-command surfaces, terminal geometry and embedded Clients are not implemented.

renderComponents.name: Spinner
renderComponents.note: Live runtime status and custom word/message/suffix; mode uses existing requesting/responding/thinking/tool-input/tool-use state. Native spinner remains when unchanged. Electron11 and focused status2.

renderComponents.name: TurnDuration
renderComponents.note: Live completed assistant duration; 32 independent owners with cancellation on recycling. Terminal onScreen absent. Native timing/header retained. Electron11 and focused status2.

renderComponents.name: InfoNotice
renderComponents.note: Actual completion interruption notices; no fabricated host notices. Client rejected. Electron11 verifies the real completion loop and default restoration.

renderComponents.name: SessionMode

renderComponents.name: PromptHint

renderComponents.name: AbovePrompt
renderComponents.note: Live composer band with bounded desktop geometry and controls. Embedded Client is rejected; terminal geometry is adapted. Global off/on and cold mount verified in Electron11.

renderComponents.name: Pane

Real pane and Client Electron svg1; not unrestricted SVG parity.
